verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack names the GGUF format. The docs say LM Studio runs local models and serves inference via `llama.cpp` or `Apple MLX`, but linking llama.cpp to GGUF would take outside knowledge. Generic download-and-run claims do not show GGUF-specific loading.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and run models packaged in the GGUF format
